## First product: name tag

Start with a simple product that gives you something real to design, make, test, photograph, and improve. Create a name tag that clearly shows your name, can stand at your workspace, and can later incorporate your personal logo.

Use the [NICE Design Process](../resources/nice-design-process.qmd) to identify needs, rank useful extras, investigate possible solutions, create a first version, and evaluate it against the requirements before improving it.

## Personal marque

Create a simplified automotive-style mark that can be recognized at small size, reproduced cleanly, and manufactured as a physical badge or decal.

## Personal emblem

Develop a richer identity piece that can show more of your values, place, heritage, interests, and aspirations.

## Shop log

Use photographs, measurements, brief captions, procedures, results, and reflections to document technical work as it happens. The shop log becomes a portfolio without requiring a long essay for every task.
